title: seti-ellipsoid-broker: an account-free SN 1987A SETI Ellipsoid target broker
description: A Python pipeline that computes which stars are currently crossing the SN 1987A SETI Ellipsoid, fusing transient alerts with anonymous Gaia DR3 astrometry (with the Lindegren et al. 2021 parallax zero-point correction), validated against the 217 SN 1987A targets of Nilipour et al. (2023).
